authors: I. Aya, K. Yamane, H. Nariai
title: Solubility of CO2 and density of CO2 hydrate at 30 MPa
needs_pass2_reason: text layer clean; every cell matched the page image (Table 1, journal p. 267)
experimental_method: Loop-type high-pressure facility simulating 3000 m ocean depth; circulating water at 30 MPa cooled until CO2 hydrate precipitated; sample water depressurised into a flexible bag, evaporated gas volume and total weight measured to give CO2 mass fraction.
quality_remarks: Temperatures in parentheses (Delta T) were measured at a different time from C; test 8 C0 and Delta C are estimated. Temperature scale not stated. Estimated hydrate density (1.09-1.11) is derived, not tabulated.
extraction_notes: Concentration C is a mass fraction (printed in the figure axis as CO2 concentration (-)).
